interpretation: 57.7% of Chicago opioid deaths occur in the victim's home ZIP code — consistent with using at/near home, often alone. This is exactly the scenario a fixed box cannot reach in time, and why TAKE-HOME distribution (carry it with you) is the right mechanism: the naloxone goes home with the person who picked it up.
caveat: ZIP-match is a coarse proxy; residence street address is not public.
